title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 421 (Appeal from orders of Tribunal)

content.overview: A person aggrieved by an order of the Tribunal may appeal to the Appellate Tribunal within forty-five days, on a question of law or fact.
content.glance: A person aggrieved by an order of the Tribunal may appeal to the Appellate Tribunal within forty-five days, on a question of law or fact.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: A person aggrieved by an order of the Tribunal may appeal to the Appellate Tribunal within forty-five days, on a question of law or fact.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: The Appellate Tribunal may condone a further period not exceeding forty-five days. An order passed with the consent of the parties is not appealable. The appeal does not itself stay the order.
